FINANCE COMMITTEE
                                    MINUTES

A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Tuesday, February 4, 2025, in Committee Room
104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Pete Laybourn. Chairman; Ken EsquibeI Mark Moody; and Scott
Roybal.


                                    AGENDA ITEMS

11.    LEASES/CONTRACTS/LEGAL:

       h)     Lease Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the Girl Scouts of Montana
              and Wyoming, for 45.93 acres of city-owned real property located near the former
              Roundtop Water Treatment Facility to be used for the purposes of conducting
              activities consistent with the By-Laws and Articles of Incorporation of the Girl
              Scouts of Montana and Wyoming. (Revenue to the City)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount of $100.00, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided a staff report and Derry Fritz,
Girl Scouts of Montana and Wyoming, provided additional information. Committee members
Esquihel and Roybal commented on the item.

12.    CONTRACT MODIFICATIONS:

       a)     Contract Modification #1 to Contract #8070 with Wyoming Department of Health,
              Aging Division to provide transportation support services to persons 60 years or
              older under the Title IIIB Program Grant for FY25. (IIIB Division on Aging Grant)

Mr. Roybal moved to approve in an amount of $10,192.00. seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion
carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report and Erin Johnson, newly
hired Transit Director, introduced herself to the committee. Committee member Roybal
commented on the item.

13.    CONSIDERATION OF BIDS/PURCHASES/REQUESTS FOR PROPOSALS:

       e)     Consideration of Bid #S-1l-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and Academy Sports Turf Inc., for the Pioneer Park Baseball Field Synthetic Turf
              Replacement Project. (One Time State Distribution Funds, Community Facility
              Fees)
